target_customer: Engineering and hardware teams needing simulation, and data center operators needing real-time thermal control
problem: Engineers spend large effort setting up physics simulations, and generic AI approximations can be wrong. Standard Physics runs real numerical solvers driven by AI agents.
business_model: outcome-based engineering for design search, open-source core simulator, and software for data center thermal control

founders.name: Kabir Jain
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder and CEO with no background.

founders.name: Ziming Qiu
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder and CTO on the YC page; no background found.

competitors.name: Navier AI
competitors.what: agent-driven CFD platform built on OpenFOAM

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating mesh generation and solver runs reliably through agents is hard, and real-time digital twins of buildings need fast physics models.

defensibility.rationale: Core simulator is open source. Agent orchestration over OpenFOAM was being done by other startups and academic groups.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SimScale released a simulation AI agent to its community on 2026-08-18, after the batch.

market_need_then: Simulation setup is slow and expert-driven, and data center cooling demand was rising. No customer evidence for this company is public.

branding.domain_note: standardphysics.com is used; the contact email still uses the inviscidai.com domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, emphasises real numerical solvers over approximation.

rebrands.why: not stated; confirmed only by a Dealroom profile and the company site copyright, date unknown

brand_strength.rationale: Little press. The rebrand leaves the old name still in use across directories, splitting recognition.

outcome_analysis: Standard Physics (formerly Inviscid AI) joined YC in Winter 2026 as a two-person team and is Active. It widened from data center digital twins to a general physics engine with open-source Reynolds and the Archimedes design search. No funding, exit or shutdown was found, so there is no outcome to explain yet.
notes: Dealroom shows a $125k seed round and another aggregator a $500K seed in January 2026, both unverified single-aggregator figures. A VCBacked listing says Standard Physics is a Singapore company with a $2.3M seed; it is likely a different firm and is ignored. Rebrand date unknown.
